verdict.rationale: The docs show agents working autonomously across editor, terminal, and browser. Agents can hand test runs to subagents and run in the background on isolated worktrees. They produce reviewable Artifacts, including code diffs and browser recordings that serve as a demo, and halt for your approval. However, execution runs in local desktop sessions that you drive remotely, not in a hosted cloud agent. Missing for 10: evidence of cloud-hosted agent execution, and independent hands-on corroboration of a full build-test-demo run.
